changes.oldText: When you open the WebUI in a browser older than the supported versions, the WebUI does not load. The loading screen shows a message that the browser is not supported, with the list of supported browsers. Update the browser or use one of the supported browsers.
changes.newText: When you open the WebUI in a browser older than the supported versions, the loading screen shows a message that the browser is not supported, with the list of supported browsers, and the WebUI does not load. Update the browser or use one of the supported browsers. To use the WebUI in that browser anyway, click Use anyway under the message and then Continue in the confirmation dialog. Normal behavior is not guaranteed, and the message appears again in a new tab or after you log out.
